title: Let the toolbar of the handover log be moved to the top
goal: When the log window scrolls, keep the block title and jump entry at the top of the window.
summary: position: sticky puts the toolbar in its original layout position. After setting top: 0, the toolbar will stop at the edge when it scrolls to the top of the nearest scroll container.
tasks: Add position: sticky and top: 0 to .log-toolbar after its layout rules.
Click "Skip to latest record" and check that the toolbar is still attached to the top of the list window after the log is scrolled. Keep the original two-column layout of the toolbar.

example.note: When the appointment schedule is scrolled, the title remains at the top edge of the window, and the background covers the text passing below it.

hint: If the toolbar rolls away with the record, check whether top has been set to 0. The .log-panel it is in has a separate scrolling area set up.
